summary: CR-060 Table/Room Management CRUD wiring verified. Frontend loads without errors, login works, Sidebar shows 'Table Management' (no Coming Soon), SettingsPanel → Table Management tile renders TableManagementView with data-testid='table-management-view'. All 3 backend APIs return 200 OK from preprod.mygenie.online (table-config, area-options, waiter-list). Add Table/Room dialog opens with Type toggle, Number input, Area combobox, Waiter dropdown (all correct data-testids). Bulk Editor renders spreadsheet grid with 14 items. Barrel export from panels/index.js works. Constants, services, transforms are correctly defined. Webpack compiled with only 1 aggregated warning (all pre-existing eslint react-hooks/exhaustive-deps in reports-module and unrelated files) — NO new warnings from CR-060 files. Found 1 UI bug: default 'All' section shows empty grid due to area-options API returning ['', null, 'out', 'in'] leading to selectedArea being set to empty string.

ui_bugs.issue: On first load, 'All' section header displays but grid is empty ('0 Tables & Rooms', 'No tables in this section') even though sidebar shows 14 tables. Root cause: area-options API returns ['', null, 'out', 'in']. In fetchAll() (line 47-48), `setSelectedArea(areasRes[0])` sets selectedArea to empty string ''. Then header text `{selectedArea || 'All'}` falls back to 'All' via truthy check, BUT filter logic `selectedArea === 'All'` is false (since selectedArea is ''), so filter runs `tables.filter(t => (t.title || 'Unassigned') === '')` = 0 matches.

action_items: Fix TableManagementView.jsx fetchAll() selectedArea default: filter out empty/null from areasRes before setting default, OR always default to 'All'. Suggested fix: replace lines 47-48 with `if (!selectedArea) setSelectedArea('All');` — the API's area list is redundant here since sections are derived from `tables` data (allAreas).
Also sanitize areasRes in area combobox dropdown (dialog-area-select) to drop empty and null entries so users don't see blank options.
critical_code_review_comments: TableManagementView line 47-48: `setSelectedArea(areasRes[0])` is fragile — API returned areas can contain empty string/null. Either sanitize `areasRes` (filter Boolean) before use, or drop this branch and default to 'All'.

The areas state (from API) is not used to render section list — `allAreas` is derived from `tables` state. The `areas` API state is only used in Add dialog area combobox. Consider deleting the state to reduce noise, or sanitize before use.
fetchAll useCallback depends on selectedArea but useEffect uses [] with eslint-disable — harmless because refreshAll calls fetchAll directly; still worth noting.
Constants (TABLE_CONFIG* endpoints) at /app/frontend/src/api/constants.js lines 24-30 look correct.
tableService.js exports all 8 required functions (getTableConfig, storeTable, deleteTable, getAreaOptions, getWaiterList, exportSampleTemplate, exportTableList, importTables).
Sidebar.jsx line 106 has TABLE Management without comingSoon flag and with path — verified in UI (no 'Coming Soon' badge).
SettingsPanel.jsx line 13 imports TableManagementView, line 42 maps 'table-management' correctly.
components/panels/index.js line 16 re-exports TableManagementView as named export.

rca_of_the_issue: BUG: 'All' section empty on first load. In TableManagementView.jsx fetchAll() (lines 41-48), the area-options API returns data.areas = ['', null, 'out', 'in']. Code path: `if (!selectedArea && areasRes?.length) setSelectedArea(areasRes[0])` → sets selectedArea = '' (empty string, first element of array). Downstream: header uses `{selectedArea || 'All'}` which falls back to displaying 'All' (misleading), but filter uses `selectedArea === 'All'` (strict equality) which is false, so falls to `tables.filter(t => (t.title || 'Unassigned') === '')` — no table's title equals '' after the 'Unassigned' fallback, hence 0 results. FIX: Either (a) sanitize areasRes with `.filter(Boolean)` before use, or (b) always default `setSelectedArea('All')` since section list is derived from tables, not from area API. Reproduction: login as owner@18march.com, Settings → All Settings → Table Management → observe 'All (0 Tables & Rooms)' header while sidebar shows 'All 14'. Clicking any other section (Unassigned/in/out) works correctly.
